title: Laravel Project Structure: Folder-by-Folder Tour
objectives: Har main folder ka kaam samajhna
Naye folders kab banenge yeh jaanna
Laravel 10 aur Laravel 11+ ke structure ka farak jaanna
prerequisites: Pehla Laravel Project Banana aur Chalana (m02-l03)

sections.heading: Real-world example: Ghar ka naksha
sections.body: Laravel project ek ghar jaisa hai. `routes` darwaza hai, `app` mein kamre (logic) hain, `resources/views` drawing room hai jo mehman dekhte hain, `storage` store-room hai, aur `public` ghar ka gate hai jo bahar ke logon se milta hai.

sections.heading: Folder tree
sections.body: Naye Laravel project ka default structure kuch aisa dikhta hai:

code.code:
example-app/
├── app/
│   ├── Http/
│   │   └── Controllers/
│   ├── Models/
│   └── Providers/
├── bootstrap/        (app.php, providers.php, cache/)
├── config/
├── database/         (factories, migrations, seeders)
├── public/           (index.php, assets)
├── resources/        (css, js, views)
├── routes/           (web.php, console.php)
├── storage/          (app, framework, logs)
├── tests/
├── vendor/
├── .env
├── artisan
├── composer.json
└── package.json

explain: `app/` – tumhare application ka zyada tar code. Default mein sirf `Http`, `Models`, `Providers` hote hain. Baaki folders tab bante hain jab tum `make:` commands chalate ho.
`bootstrap/` – framework ko boot karne wali `app.php`, aur performance ke liye `cache/`.
`public/` – web server ka document root. `index.php` yahin hai aur images/CSS/JS bhi.
`storage/` – logs, cache, compiled views, uploaded files.
`vendor/` – Composer packages. Isme kabhi edit mat karo.

sections.heading: bootstrap/app.php: application ka control room
sections.body: Laravel 11 se routing, middleware aur exception handling yahin configure hoti hai. Yeh file tumhare version ke hisaab se thodi alag dikh sakti hai, par structure yahi rehta hai.

code.code:
<?php

use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Middleware;

return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
    ->withRouting(
        web: __DIR__.'/../routes/web.php',
        commands: __DIR__.'/../routes/console.php',
        health: '/up',
    )
    ->withMiddleware(function (Middleware $middleware) {
        //
    })
    ->withExceptions(function (Exceptions $exceptions) {
        //
    })->create();

explain: `withRouting()` – kaunsi route files load hongi. `health: '/up'` ek health-check URL deta hai.
`withMiddleware()` – global middleware yahin set hota hai (Module 13).
`withExceptions()` – errors kaise handle ya report hon.

sections.heading: public aur storage ka rishta
sections.body: User ki uploaded files `storage/app/public` mein rakhte hain, par browser sirf `public` folder dekh sakta hai. Isliye ek **symbolic link** banate hain:
explain: Baad mein file upload wale module (Module 14) mein ise dobara use karenge.

sections.heading: Optional route files
sections.body: Agar tumhe API ya broadcasting chahiye, to default project mein `api.php` aur `channels.php` nahi hote. Unhe yeh commands banate hain:

code.code:
php artisan install:api
php artisan install:broadcasting

callout.text: Naya class chahiye? Folder khud mat banao, `php artisan make:controller`, `make:model` jaisi commands chalao. Woh sahi jagah aur sahi namespace mein file bana deti hain.

versionDiff.heading: Laravel 10 aur 11, 12, 13 ka structure
versionDiff.intro: Laravel 11 mein skeleton bahut slim hua. Laravel 12 aur 13 us layout ko hi aage badhate hain.

items.11: Slim skeleton: `app/Http/Kernel.php`, `app/Console/Kernel.php`, `app/Exceptions/Handler.php` aur `RouteServiceProvider` nahi hote. Yeh sab `bootstrap/app.php` mein configure hota hai.
items.13: Default `app` mein `Http`, `Models`, `Providers` hi hote hain. Layout 11 aur 12 jaisa hai.

errors.cause: File galat folder mein hai ya namespace folder path se match nahi karta.
errors.fix: Namespace aur folder path match karo, case-sensitive (Linux server), aur `composer dump-autoload` chalao.

errors.error: The stream or file "storage/logs/laravel.log" could not be opened: Permission denied
errors.cause: `storage` ya `bootstrap/cache` par web server ko write permission nahi hai.
errors.fix: In folders ko web server user ke liye writable banao (jaise `chmod -R 775 storage bootstrap/cache` aur sahi owner).

errors.error: Uploaded file ka URL 404 de raha hai

debug.body: Structure aur environment ka quick summary `php artisan about` deta hai. Registered routes `route:list` se dikhte hain.

code.code:
php artisan about
php artisan route:list
php artisan list make

tasks: Apne project mein har folder kholo aur ek line mein uska kaam likho
`php artisan make:controller TestController` chalao aur dekho file kahan bani
`php artisan storage:link` chalao aur `public/storage` check karo

quiz.q: Web server ka document root kaunsa folder hona chahiye?
quiz.why: Sirf `public` web se accessible hona chahiye.

quiz.q: Laravel 11+ mein routing aur middleware kahan configure hote hain?

quiz.why: Yeh ek symbolic link banata hai taaki uploaded files browser se dikh sakein.

interview.q: Laravel ka `app` folder kya hota hai?
interview.a: Application ka core code, PSR-4 se `App` namespace mein autoload hota hai. Default mein `Http`, `Models`, `Providers`.
`web.php` browser ke HTTP routes (web middleware group ke saath: session, CSRF). `console.php` Artisan console commands ke liye.

interview.q: `vendor` folder ka kya kaam hai? Ise commit kyun nahi karte?
interview.a: Composer ke packages hote hain. `composer install` se dobara ban sakta hai, isliye version control mein nahi daalte.

interview.q: Laravel 11 ne structure mein kya badla?
interview.a: Skeleton slim hua: Kernel files, Handler aur RouteServiceProvider hataye gaye aur `bootstrap/app.php` mein configuration aayi.
Sab HTTP requests ka entry point, jo autoloader aur application bootstrap karke request handle karta hai.

summary: `app` logic, `routes` URLs, `resources` views, `public` gate, `storage` generated files.
`make:` commands sahi folder aur namespace mein files banati hain.
`storage:link` se uploaded files public hoti hain.
Layout Laravel 11, 12, 13 mein lagbhag same hai.
